label: frontier • build a tested Python CLI end to end and deliver it
query: Build a small Python CLI tool in this folder. Requirements: (1) create calc.py using argparse with two subcommands — 'add A B' prints the integer sum of A and B, 'mul A B' prints the integer product — printing ONLY the number; (2) create test_calc.py with unittest tests covering both subcommands; (3) run the tests with 'python3 -m unittest discover -q' and make sure they pass before finishing. The files in this workspace are the deliverable.
notes: Frontier outcome discipline under the lean contract: build, self-verify, and finish in normal assistant text. Workspace writes are already delivered; no lifecycle or artifact tool is required.
